vulnerabilities.name: VIN_Write_Overflow
vulnerabilities.description: Writing to VIN DID 0xF190 with payload > 17 bytes causes buffer overflow in the door lock controller NVM write buffer

effect.log_message: NVM write buffer overflow on VIN DID 0xF190 — door lock controller unresponsive

vulnerabilities.name: Security_Bypass_Magic_Byte
vulnerabilities.description: WriteDID to any door DID (0xF601–0xF604) with first data byte 0xAA bypasses SecurityAccess check entirely — doors can be unlocked without authentication

effect.log_message: Magic byte 0xAA on door WriteDID — SecurityAccess bypassed, physical lock override possible

vulnerabilities.name: ISO_TP_Segment_Overlap
vulnerabilities.description: Sending overlapping multi-frame ISO-TP consecutive frames (SN wrap at 0x0F→0x00) to CAN ID 0x19B causes reassembly buffer corruption in the door lock gateway module

effect.log_message: ISO-TP sequence number wrap caused reassembly buffer corruption on 0x19B — ECU reset required

vulnerabilities.name: Programming_Session_Without_Extended
vulnerabilities.description: Programming session (0x02) accepted without prior Extended session (0x03) — illegal state transition allows unauthorized firmware flashing of the door lock module

effect.log_message: Unauthorized Programming Session transition on DLOCK — firmware flash vector exposed

vulnerabilities.name: Diagnostic_Session_Leaking
vulnerabilities.description: ECU responds to ReadDID 0xF60A (fault code) and 0xF609 (command count) in Default session without requiring Extended session — internal lock state exposed to unauthenticated tester

effect.log_message: Sensitive DIDs 0xF60A/0xF609 readable in Default session — lock state and fault history exposed

vulnerabilities.name: Weak_Seed_Entropy
vulnerabilities.description: SecurityAccess (0x27 subfunction 0x01) always returns a static seed 0xBEEF regardless of session or timestamp — brute-force attack completes in under 65536 attempts

effect.log_message: Predictable seed 0xBEEF issued — SecurityAccess brute-force possible in O(65536)

vulnerabilities.name: Door_Unlock_Without_Auth
vulnerabilities.description: WriteDID to any door DID (0xF601–0xF604) accepted in Default session without SecurityAccess — all four doors can be remotely unlocked by any unauthenticated CAN node

effect.log_message: Door unlock WriteDID accepted in Default session — no SecurityAccess required, vehicle entry bypass possible

vulnerabilities.name: Child_Lock_Disable_No_Auth
vulnerabilities.description: WriteDID to child lock DIDs 0xF606/0xF607 accepted without any session or security check — child safety locks can be disabled remotely

effect.log_message: Child lock 0xF606/0xF607 written without auth — rear door safety bypass possible

vulnerabilities.name: Trunk_Release_Without_Auth
vulnerabilities.description: WriteDID to trunk DID 0xF605 with value 0x01 accepted in Default session — trunk can be opened remotely without any authentication from any CAN node on the bus

effect.log_message: Trunk release DID 0xF605 accepted without auth — cargo access bypass possible

vulnerabilities.name: Rapid_Lock_Unlock_DoS
vulnerabilities.description: Rapid alternating WriteDID lock (0x00) / unlock (0x01) to door DIDs at >50 Hz causes the actuator driver IC to enter overcurrent fault mode and stop responding

effect.log_message: Door actuator driver overcurrent fault — lock/unlock motor disabled for 5 seconds
